decision_rule.primary_metric: paired net marked return difference in percentage points over identical calendar
decision_rule.classification: Net return higher and DD no higher: descriptive favorable result only. Lower return and higher DD: descriptive unfavorable result. Otherwise: trade-off/inconclusive. Equality within declared numerical tolerance is no improvement.
decision_rule.numerical_tolerance: return 1e-8 percentage points; DD 1e-8 percentage points; numerical comparison only, not statistical significance
decision_rule.qualification: No winner/promotion or alpha claim from this already-seen single window, regardless of classification

preflight.source_identity_location: receipt.source; historical snapshot, recheck before execution freeze
preflight.control_signal_adapter: ma_vol_target with fast20/slow80, signal-only; fixed sizing must override any volatility targeting in future execution
preflight.execution_compatibility: PENDING: source differs from historical replay; signal parity alone does not establish execution parity

execution.engine: existing MarketReplayEngine V2, exploratory simulation only
execution.signal_timing: canonical signal at j uses head(j); execution at j+1; confirm parity for both MA arms
execution.strategy_stop: 5% average fill cost; prior completed low triggers next-open market exit
execution.risk_halt: DD15% / UTC day loss8%, prior closed marks
execution.cost_and_microstructure: Copy full reviewed reference SimulationConfig, including fee, spread, depth, latency, impact, precision; no silent defaults
execution.terminal_mark: no forced liquidation; carry marked at final close
execution.benchmark_exit_policy: cash stays cash; buy-hold enters once, no strategy stop/cooldown; common fee/mark and safety conventions; report policy distinction
